name: watchtower-durable-scan-completion-ledger
instr:
Watchtower does not retain durable scan-attempt history across run-once, HTTP, and scheduled execution. Add stable identities and accounting that correlate operational observations after restart without changing existing responses, notifications, scheduling, Prometheus observations, shutdown behavior, or representations.

Every accepted attempt gets one non-empty identity and exactly one durable terminal outcome. Unknown completion returns `ErrAttemptNotFound`; contradictory completion returns `ErrInvalidTransition` without changing state. Records use one increasing sequence and retain identities and counts when reopened. List them oldest-to-newest after keeping the requested newest records; zero returns all retained records. Malformed durable content returns `ErrCorruptLedger` without discarding readable history.

Keep scanned, updated, failed, restarted, and skipped counts identical across completion, session data, notifications, metrics, partial failures, cancellation, and repeated observation. Correlate metric accounting by attempt. Contradictory duplicates return `ErrMetricConflict` without changing Prometheus totals; legacy metrics without identities still work.

Record one appropriate terminal decision for every trigger, including admission rejection, timeout, asynchronous completion, overlap, missing hooks, parent-container skips, execution failure, and cancellation.
